name: Asymmetric Value Matrix with Symmetric Boolean Projection
description: Replaced the odd/even matrix with one where values are highly asymmetric and lack any parity pattern. The new safety condition is "NOT a multiple of 5", which projects the asymmetric integer matrix into a perfectly symmetric boolean matrix (safe iff x != y). Combined with explicitly defining the input pairs as directed transmissions, this breaks the model's parity-based undirected-adjacency shortcut without altering the true valid assignments, forcing it to write directed logic that may fail to prune correctly.
